title: Durable Hytale material learning across world restarts and pack recovery
summary: Adaptive Surface 1.0.1 on Hytale 0.7.4 persists newly requested material IDs immediately, prepares required local tint inputs before orderly shutdown, and reports pending or blocked materials honestly. Controlled native-server tests pass; the user reports the delivered 1.0.1 now works, without a detailed client trace.
problem_class: durable asset discovery before pre-start registration
problem_description: A mod acknowledges a material discovery during gameplay, but its generated asset pack is registered only at the next world start. A delayed or failed background build can lose the request or leave the player in a false reopen loop.
context: Adaptive Surface 1.0.0 on Hytale 0.7.4 lost both native and biome-tinted requests when the background worker was delayed six seconds and the server shut down normally. Pack recovery also emitted the saved/reopen message while learning was suspended. 1.0.1 was delivered with source and publication files separate; the user then reported it works. The specific original second-PC failure mechanism was not isolated from its logs.
outputs: locally generated pack on next start
previous working pack preserved on fatal input error
constraints: Preserve approved material/state IDs and geometry
No native or third-party texture pixels in public JAR
Hytale assets registered only before clients join
Do not treat a single user report as cross-version stability
known_attempts: deferred background-only request save with two-second shutdown wait
handwritten discovery file and synchronous prepare() release fixtures

solution_versions.description: Adaptive Surface 1.0.1 writes the material request journal during selection, processes required tint inputs before an orderly shutdown, reconstructs the pack from persisted data at startup, and distinguishes preparing, prepared and blocked states. Unresolvable fresh donors remain visible in pendingInputs while saved P/Q identities still fail closed.
changes: Persist each new request before showing it as recorded; a delayed optional ZIP worker cannot be the only durable store.
Flush tint inputs while donor assets are still loaded at orderly shutdown, then rebuild before asset registration on the next start.
Use a read-only RocksDb saved-palette scan on Hytale 0.7.4 and require only Surface IDs, explicit requests and retained material tokens.
Report unresolved fresh donors separately so one obsolete tint request does not starve valid discoveries; preserve the existing pack on missing saved assets.
advantages: First orderly restart activates reproduced native and tinted materials
Saved Surface materials and working packs remain protected
Failure messages and reports identify whether an input is still pending or blocked
disadvantages: Abrupt power loss during an in-progress file write is outside the reproduced orderly-shutdown test
Eight historical appearances still require surviving approved inputs
The actual second-PC client session did not supply logs identifying its exact trigger
test_results: Unchanged 1.0.0 production-byte-identical probe loses two requests with a six-second worker delay; 1.0.1 persists both immediately and loads both at first restart under the same delay.
Persistent scan fault preserves working pack SHA-256 over two boots and selects blocked message; RocksDb world copy learns and loads on restart.
A stale donor request remains pending while valid discoveries activate; 32 native placements including learned material persist across reload with zero geometry mismatches.
Final 1.0.1 JAR SHA-256 55e316255eb5a4dcca131065c03214d413fc8eb7120fec450f0af03e0c694c8f starts and restarts alone; user reports the delivered version works.

source_refs.description: Detailed gate report and publication scope

transferability: For any game mod that activates discovered assets only at next startup, persist the request at the moment of acknowledgement and test real selection, orderly shutdown and first restart under a delayed worker. Treat missing inputs as pending and preserve already saved asset IDs. RocksDb reader details and pixel budgets are Hytale-version-specific.
